title: Indices & surds
blurb: Powers, roots, and rationalising a denominator.
hlLink: You need this before logs, binomial expansions, and exact trig values.

items.solution: Add the indices in the product, then subtract: $2^{3+4-5}=2^{2}=4$.
Any non-zero number to the power $0$ is $1$.

title: Data & chance
blurb: Mean, median, and the first probability rules.
hlLink: Combined events and binomial probability assume these without a reminder.

items.solution: The ordered list has five values, so the middle one is $7$.

items.prompt: A fair $6$-sided die is rolled. Find the probability of an even number.
items.solution: Three of the six faces are even.

items.prompt: Two fair coins are flipped. Find the probability of two heads. ($n$)
items.solution: The outcomes are HH, HT, TH, TT, all equally likely.

items.prompt: A bag has $3$ red and $5$ blue balls. One is drawn at random. Find $\mathrm{P}(\text{red})$.

Two fair dice are rolled. Find the probability both show a $6$.

items.solution: Middle two are $7$ and $10$; mean is $8.5$.

items.prompt: A fair die is rolled. Find $\mathrm{P}(\text{prime number})$.
items.solution: Primes on a die: $2,3,5$ — three of six.
